tally.citation: Bug describes a git clone initialization defect in the mcp entrypoint's tickets volume handling; epic delivers LLM request headers and correlation for gateway observability, touching only llm/runner.py, structured_run.py, and config surfaces — no overlap with git clone or tracker initialization logic.
tally.title: mcp entrypoint trusts a bare .git, so one interrupted clone poisons the tickets volume permanently

tally.citation: Bug describes a blocking synchronous clone in mcp entrypoint; epic delivers configurable LLM request headers for gateway observability with no changes to service boot, entrypoint, or ticket store initialization.
tally.title: mcp entrypoint blocks boot on a 199k-commit tickets clone, so every blue-green deploy fails the 120s health gate and rolls back

tally.citation: Bug describes a control-flow defect in autodeploy.sh unrelated to the epic's LLM request headers, correlation identity, or verdict trace_id delivery.
tally.title: autodeploy: a review-bot deferral exit 0s the script, so the 'independent' mcp blue-green deploy never runs

tally.citation: Bug describes stale review-queue processing in review_bot/app.py, unrelated to LLM request headers, correlation IDs, or gateway observability that the epic delivers.
tally.title: Review bot reviews superseded patchsets: the queue never re-checks current revision before starting a review
